scenarios.name: A/B replay smoke round-trip against the real API
scenarios.given: an isolated temp plugin root with config/jev.json forced enabled:true / both features audit, and a fixed 5-prompt corpus (2 DEBUG-shaped, 1 PLAN-shaped, 1 REVIEW-shaped, 1 BUILD-shaped, chosen to exercise every workflow_type bucket)
scenarios.when: the real replay driver (craftflow_jev_replay.py) runs all 5 prompts through the real hook and then craftflow_jev_ab_report.py runs over the resulting isolated events.jsonl + replay_manifest.jsonl
scenarios.then: replay produces exactly 10 telemetry rows (5 routing + 5 skill, no prompt text), the manifest has exactly 5 rows (no prompt text), and the A/B report exits 0 with routing.n == 5 and every routing row's heuristic_result.workflow deterministic (re-derivable from craftflow_jev_heuristic.classify() on the same 5 fixed prompt strings)
scenarios.expected: exit 0; 10 telemetry rows (5 routing + 5 skill); 5 manifest rows; no prompt text; routing.n == 5; heuristic determinism verified
